name: wtf-meter
description: Counts the swearing in your prompts (English, German, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian): a heat meter, a swear jar, or Bluey-style child-friendly swaps

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: meter: how heated this session is (cools down). jar: a swear jar that only fills, 25 cents per point. bluey: shows a child-friendly swap for each stronger swear (biscuits!) and counts your clean streak.

jarOnlyFor.title: Jar mode only for this account
jarOnlyFor.description: Jar mode applies only when the signed-in email ends with this, e.g. @company.com; other accounts get the meter. Empty: every account.

slackChannel.title: Slack channel
slackChannel.description: Jar mode posts here through your Slack connector, e.g. swear-jar or a channel ID. Empty: the jar stays local.

slackOnlyFor.title: Post only from this account
slackOnlyFor.description: Jar mode posts only when the signed-in email ends with this, e.g. @company.com. Empty: any account.
